steps.why: Re-fit the model on the latest data to ensure up-to-date parameters.
Run performance, calibration, stability, fairness, and data quality detectors to identify any issues.

data.rationale: The model is a credit limit assignment strategy where fairness and stability are critical. Running a challenger, slice search, and stress test will uncover potential performance gaps, segment-specific biases, and robustness concerns.
